name: Joshua Rotenberg
role: Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing & Custom Solutions
body: Your line about seeing the whole campaign, ideas becoming sellable programs and sold programs becoming executable plans, is the work I've done for 15 years. At Level Agency I managed integrated programs across paid media, email, content, and landing pages, with about 3 accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend, and reported results back in QBRs. At Wix I led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, coaching them weekly while we launched 25+ clients a month at 120% of sales targets.

I'm most useful in the space between Sales and delivery. I've sat on both sides as a quota-carrying seller and as the person who owns the handoff, so I know where scopes slip and approvals stall, and I build the tracking that catches it before the client does.

I'll be direct about the gaps: my background is digital, not print or publishing, and I haven't run sponsored content or branded video programs. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
